entities.summary: Yi-Cheng Wang is a Taiwanese professional baseball coach for the Rakuten Monkeys of the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL). He has previously played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yokohama DeNA BayStars, and in the CPBL for the Lamigo Monkeys/Rakuten Monkeys.
